description: This Java class 'ImmutableEntityIdWithResourceType' implements the 'EntityIdWithResourceType' interface, representing an entity ID combined with a resource type, including serialization/deserialization, equality, and hash code methods.

classes.name: ImmutableEntityIdWithResourceType
classes.description: Immutable class implementing EntityIdWithResourceType, encapsulating resource type, entity ID, and optional cache lookup context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an EntityIdWithResourceType instance with resource type and ID, without cache lookup context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an EntityIdWithResourceType instance with resource type, ID, and cache lookup context.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Deserializes an EntityIdWithResourceType from a string, expecting format 'resourceType:id'.

methods.name: getCacheLookupContext
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the cache lookup context if present.
